appOverview: Configuración is reached from Dashboard's settings-menu (which stops being a disabled placeholder) and is three separate top-level views: app-teacher-settings-view (/configuracion/profesor — edit the signed-in teacher's full name; change password), app-training-catalog-settings-view (/configuracion/ciclos-modulos — master CRUD over a brand-new, standalone catalog of ciclos formativos and módulos profesionales, seeded from the official BOC curricula), and app-academic-year-settings-view (/configuracion/ano-academico — UI ONLY as of the 2026-08-04 redesign, see below). Each has its own Shadow DOM and is reached by a plain nav link (teacher-nav-link / training-catalog-nav-link / academic-year-nav-link) rendered identically on all three screens via one shared function. **Redesign 2026-08-04**: the tables that used to back Año académico (training_cycles, modules, academic_years, academic_year_modules) were dropped. Ciclos/Módulos does NOT reuse or replace them — it owns two brand-new tables (catalog_cycles, catalog_modules) with zero relation to años académicos, so there is no dependency-blocked deletion in that screen (cascade delete only) and no edit-confirmation modal (nothing references a catalog módulo to warn about). Año académico's UI and components are kept exactly as previously designed — same tables, same three-mode behavior (normal/adding-year/adding-cycle), same elementIds — but this pass gives it no working backend: requirement-architect generates no api-contracts.md entries or schema-changes.sql for it, tdd-engineer writes no test asserting real HTTP/persistence for it, and frontend-implementer wires it to a local-state-only stub so the screen renders and every interaction still works visually, without talking to a server. This is a deliberate, temporary state — a future view rebuilds Año académico's real data layer.

globalRules: This is three separate top-level custom elements (app-teacher-settings-view, app-training-catalog-settings-view, app-academic-year-settings-view), each its own Shadow DOM, each its own route. Shared nav markup (teacher-nav-link/training-catalog-nav-link/academic-year-nav-link) comes from one plain function called by all three
All three screens require a valid session — no session redirects to /login, same gate as Dashboard

Ciclos/Módulos (app-training-catalog-settings-view) owns two brand-new tables, catalog_cycles and catalog_modules, with no FK relation to any other table beyond users — no dependency-blocked deletion, no edit-confirmation modal, unlike the old training_cycles/modules pair
Uniqueness in Ciclos/Módulos, scoped per teacher: ciclo nombre; módulo nombre within its (ciclo, curso)

Año académico (app-academic-year-settings-view) is UI ONLY as of 2026-08-04: its former tables (training_cycles, modules, academic_years, academic_year_modules) were dropped and are not recreated in this pass. Every element on this screen operates on local component state only — no HTTP requests, no persistence across reload. This is temporary; a future view rebuilds its real data layer

requirement-architect generates no api-contracts.md entries and no schema-changes.sql for academic-year-settings-screen's elements in this pass; tdd-engineer writes no test asserting a network call or cross-reload persistence for them
